intro.heading: Owner survey for {venue}
paragraphs: This takes about 25 minutes. Figures cover the last 90 days unless a question says 12 months.
Estimates are fine: for each figure, tell us whether it’s from your records or an estimate. “Don’t know” is always an option, and a gap never counts against the venue.
On the visit, the assessor will look at a few of the records behind these figures with you, on screen. Nothing needs to be exported.

outro.heading: Thank you.
paragraphs: Your answers have gone to Good Measure.
On the visit, the assessor will look at a few of the records listed here, on screen. You’ll see a private draft of the results and have five working days to correct anything before it is final.
We delete individual answers by {deleteBy}. Questions? Contact {privateContact}.

questions.text: What do people mainly come here for?
What are your advertised opening days and hours each week?
questions.help: For example: Tue to Sat 12:00 to 23:00, Sun 12:00 to 18:00.

questions.text: How many customers or covers do you have in a typical week?
How many people work here, by contract?
What is the lowest hourly rate you pay any adult employee, before tips?
How many staff are paid at or above the real Living Wage?
What share of tips and service charge went to staff in the last three months?
Do you have a written tips policy that all staff can see?
How many staff have guaranteed minimum hours in their contract?
How many days ahead do you publish the rota?
Do you pay staff when you cancel a shift at short notice?
In the last 12 months, how many staff incidents or accidents were recorded, and how many have a recorded action?
Do you have a harassment policy with a way to report outside the line manager?
What do you provide for staff getting home after late shifts?
How many hours of paid training does a new starter get in their first month?
How many staff completed role or safety training in the last 12 months?
How many people left in the last 12 months?
How many internal promotions were there in the last 12 months?
How many qualifications or courses did you fund in the last 12 months, such as WSET or a personal licence?
How often can staff raise issues in a team meeting or one-to-one?
How many changes did you make in the last six months because staff raised them?
In the last 90 days, how many complaints did you receive, and how many got a reply within seven days?
How do staff know who is a regular or a first-timer?
How many seats suit solo guests or mixing, such as bar stools or communal tables?
Is there a quieter area or a quieter time each day?
Do you use a sound limiter or set music levels by time of day?
In the last 90 days, how many guest incidents and refusals did you record?
Which safety schemes are you part of?
Alcohol-free and low-alcohol drinks: how many are on the menu, and how do prices compare?

questions.text: Do you count repeat guests?
What share of guests visited twice or more in the last 90 days?
Which of these do you have?
In the last 90 days, how many access requests did you receive, and how many did you meet?
What do your cheapest items cost?

fields.label: Cheapest pint or glass of house wine

questions.text: Which of these charges apply?
questions.help: Write the amount or %, and whether it’s optional. Leave blank if it doesn’t apply.

questions.text: How many free or lower-cost offers do you run each week, such as early-evening prices or free events?
On how many days did you close unexpectedly in the last 90 days?
How many local groups or organisations do you work with, and how many changes did you make after community feedback in the last 12 months?

followUp.text: Give one example of a change.

questions.text: In the last 90 days, how many regular activities did you plan, how many ran, and what was typical attendance?
Do community groups get space free or at reduced cost?
How many hours did you give in the last 90 days, and what is your usual room hire fee?
Do you have entry or membership rules beyond licensing law?
How many groups meet here regularly, and what is their total attendance in a typical month?

fields.label: Total attendance in a typical month

questions.text: What was the value of free space, donations or sponsorship you gave in the last 12 months?
How many people outside your own team did you train in the last 12 months, through apprenticeships, placements, masterclasses or mentoring?
In the last 90 days, how many performers, DJs or artists did you pay, what was the total, and how many were paid within 30 days?
What share of those fees met the Musicians’ Union minimum rates?
Roughly what share of your food and drink spend goes to local and independent suppliers?
What are your usual payment terms with suppliers?
How much energy did you use in the last 12 months?
Is your energy tariff renewable?
Which waste streams do you collect separately?
What was your total waste weight in the last 12 months, if known?
Can you name two guests, two group organisers and two performers or partners we could contact, with their permission?
questions.help: If yes, we’ll ask for their details on a separate form after you send this survey.
